verdict.rationale: The documented Consensus Meter classifies each relevant paper as supporting, refuting, or mixed/inconclusive and displays the distribution (Yes/No/Possibly/Mixed/Unknown), so analysts see where the literature agrees and disagrees rather than one unqualified answer. Every response also carries citations that trace back to the source papers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the Meter's classifications are accurate, and evidence of agreement/disagreement mapping beyond yes/no-style questions (e.g., explaining why studies conflict on open-ended queries).
